column1: # Math editing regression corpus, after Obsidian's LaTeX Suite defaults.
# before<TAB>keys<TAB>expected. ‸ caret, «» selection, ↵ newline. Keys: ⇥ Tab, ⏎ Return, ⇧ Shift-Return, ⌫ Backspace, ↶ Undo, ↷ Redo.
# Auto-fraction: the term before the slash becomes the numerator.
# Nothing before the slash: it stays a slash, and a second slash makes an empty fraction (the // snippet).
# Scripts: upstream's default autofractionExcludedEnvs is ^{…} only, so subscripts still make fractions.
# Brackets around a new fraction grow to fit (auto-enlarge).
# Never a fraction: prices, escaped dollars, code, prose.
# Undo and redo after other expansions
# Typing a command by hand isn't interrupted by shortcuts
# Spelling out a command a shortcut started
